name: Latin Scorpions
description: The Latin Scorpions were likely the first Puerto Rican gang in the East Humboldt Park section of Chicago's West Town neighborhood, founded in 1964 as both a baseball club and a street gang. They made peace with the Latin Kings early on to jointly oppose white greaser gangs in the area. Most members had transitioned into what became the Maniac Latin Disciples by 1974, and the Latin Scorpions went extinct sometime in the 1970s.
